# Read-aloud voice (ElevenLabs)

Alerts, paid messages and the bot spoken on stream with an ElevenLabs voice. The sound reaches your stream through the rig page in OBS.

Choose it during setup on the **Modules** page; its setup page then appears with the steps below. The same steps are in the Admin Panel later.

The addresses below are for a site at `example.com`; your setup page shows your own.

## 1. Your ElevenLabs key and voice (optional)

ElevenLabs → Developers → API keys → Create key, with access to Text to Speech, Models and Voices. Paste it, then pick a voice in ElevenLabs' Voices page and copy its voice id. Speaking stays off until you switch it on here.

Links:

- [ElevenLabs: API keys](https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys)
- [ElevenLabs: voices](https://elevenlabs.io/app/voice-library)

This step fills:

- **ElevenLabs API key** (kept encrypted). Text-to-speech for alerts and the bot.
- **Voice**. The ElevenLabs voice id everything is spoken with (from the Voices page of your ElevenLabs account).
- **Loud voice**. The ElevenLabs voice id for shouted lines when "Loud voice for shouting" is on. Unset = the main voice.
- **Speak alerts and paid messages**. Off = nothing is ever spoken, whatever else is set (a safe default for a new install). On = alerts, paid read-aloud and the bot speak through ElevenLabs with the voices below.

Its **Test** button checks the values work before the page moves on. A step you skip stays on the Admin Panel's checklist.
